title: Austin Wakeman Scott Professor of Law, Emeritus
bio: Robert C. Clark is the Austin Wakeman Scott Professor of Law Emeritus at Harvard Law School. He was the Dean and Royall Professor of Law at Harvard Law School from 1989 through July 2003. He then served until June 2020 as the Harvard University Distinguished Service Professor and Scott Professor of Law. An authority on […]
